In each cell, the upper line is generation time; the lower line is wall runtime per phase-space point.  The left slot is the generated-library \AC\ reference value, the middle slot is \PAC\ JIT, and the right slot is \PAC\ C++ O3. Runtime multipliers are shown as \texttt{(wall|core)}. When no \AC\ reference exists but \PAC\ ran, the \PAC\ slots show absolute generation time and parenthesized \texttt{wall|core} runtime in microseconds. Colored ratios are \PAC/\AC: green below one, orange below two, red otherwise.  When rows are generated with \texttt{--validate}, \PAC\ JIT and C++ O3 values are compared to the same-point \AC\ value with a relative tolerance of \(10^{-8}\).

\paragraph{Matrix run settings.}
The matrix table is generated with one uniform benchmark setup. The full refresh command is:
\begin{lstlisting}[language=bash,breaklines=true,breakatwhitespace=true]
pyAmpliCol/dependencies/.venv/bin/python pyAmpliCol/docs/result_matrix.py --color-accuracy lc --data /Users/vjhirsch/HEP_programs/AmpliCol/pyAmpliCol/docs/result_matrix_data.json --table /Users/vjhirsch/HEP_programs/AmpliCol/pyAmpliCol/docs/result_matrix_table.tex --generate-data 1-9 --show-data 1-9 --time-limit 900 --target-runtime 1 --amplicol-points 10000 --jobs 4 --n-cores 4 --process-workers 1 --columns-per-table 3
\end{lstlisting}
\noindent\footnotesize Partial refreshes use the same settings with \texttt{--base-process}, \texttt{--skip-jit}, \texttt{--skip-cpp-o3}, \texttt{--process-ids}, or \texttt{--skip-amplicol} added only to restrict which cells are updated.  PyAmpliCol-only refreshes may additionally use \texttt{--process-workers 5}; this is intentionally disabled when the \AC\ reference is refreshed because that path uses shared top-level generated-library files.  \AC\ reference timings use the generated-library sequence \texttt{amplicol\_generate --library=create}, \texttt{make -j4 amplicol\_generate\_library}, and a direct generated-library benchmark using \texttt{--library=use}; they do not use integration-driver timings.  \PAC\ rows use the generic LC staged-DAG artifact, Rusticol double precision, JIT or C++ O3 Symbolica evaluators as labelled, and \texttt{time-process} with a one-second target runtime.  The \texttt{--time-limit} setting applies only to C++ O3 generation; \AC\ and JIT rows are left uncapped.
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{Structural reference limitations.}
For the four-quark-line row \(d\bar d\to u\bar u\,s\bar s\,c\bar c+(n-6)g\), the \AC\ reference column is a structural N/A: Fortran \AC\ stops with \texttt{Unknown number of quarks and anti-quarks}.  The \PAC\ cells are therefore shown as absolute generation/runtime timings when they are available.
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{C++ O3 compile-budget gaps.}
The following cells have validated \AC\ and \PAC\ JIT rows but no completed C++ O3 row; their C++ slot is a localized performance-generation compile-budget gap, not a physics-validation failure: $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=8\): not run; $d\bar d\to Z+(n-1)g$, \(n=9\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=8\): not run; $u\bar d\to W^++(n-1)g$, \(n=9\): not run; $d\bar d\to e^+e^-+(n-2)g$, \(n=8\): not run; $d\bar d\to e^+e^-+(n-2)g$, \(n=9\): not run; $u\bar d\to e^+\nu_e+(n-2)g$, \(n=8\): not run; $u\bar d\to e^+\nu_e+(n-2)g$, \(n=9\): not run; plus 19 more localized entries.
\par\smallskip
\paragraph{Documented JIT backend limitations.}
The following \PAC\ JIT entries are rendered as N/A because they hit a localized Symbolica/SymJIT AArch64 complex-JIT materialization limitation, not a generated-library comparison or physics-validation failure: $gg\to gg+(n-2)g$, \(n=9\), \PAC\ JIT; $d\bar d\to u\bar{u}\,s\bar{s}\,c\bar{c}+(n-6)g$, \(n=8\), \PAC\ JIT; $d\bar d\to u\bar{u}\,s\bar{s}\,c\bar{c}+(n-6)g$, \(n=9\), \PAC\ JIT.  The raw assertion is retained in \texttt{result\_matrix\_data.json}. The current managed dependency set uses SymJIT \texttt{2.19.3}, which fixes the smaller historical \texttt{v220} AArch64 JIT segfault reproduced by \texttt{MRE\_symjit\_bug\_new.py} and the pure-gluon \(n=4\) NLC/full JIT materialization case.  Cached LC backend-limit entries should be refreshed before being interpreted under this newer SymJIT version.
\par\smallskip
